context_for_next_testing_agent: Product Intake v2.5 features fully tested. CSV/TSV upload endpoint at POST /api/intake/sessions/{session_id}/upload-csv accepts multipart/form-data with 'file' field. Parser auto-detects delimiter (comma vs tab) and maps common column names. Duplicate check endpoint at GET /api/intake/items/{item_id}/check-duplicates returns duplicate_flags array and saves to item. Generate endpoint returns attribute_suggestions and fills color/size/style from suggestions if empty. Frontend has Upload CSV/TSV button, Check Dupes button in detail panel, and shows attribute_suggestions and duplicate_flags sections when present. WP Placement module unchanged and working (MOCKED WordPress REST API).
